The '''Iceberg Three Battle Group''' was one many [[Battle group/Legends|subdivisions]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]], that saw action during the [[Defense of Mon Calamari (Yuuzhan Vong War)|defense of Mon Calamari]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. It was named after the planet [[Iceberg Three]].<ref name="TUF" />
